title: Multi-model AI committee
note: The committee can now poll several DIFFERENT models (Claude + DeepSeek + Qwen via OpenRouter) that each vote accept/reduce/reject, then tallies real consensus — instead of one model playing four roles. Opt-in with an OpenRouter key; falls back to the single model otherwise.

title: Telegram bot control
note: Text commands to the bot from your phone: /status for the latest signals + book health, /scan to run a fresh scan, /analyst for the review, /test for a test alert. Handled by the always-on Cloudflare Worker, locked to your chat id.

title: Telegram alerts
note: Fresh high-conviction signals now push straight to Telegram, alongside webhook / phone-push / email. One-click alert test from the Actions tab.

title: Correlation-as-one-bet
note: Holdings whose daily returns move together (>0.75) are collapsed into a single 'bet'. The open-book panel shows Effective bets and the no-trade gate flags correlated names, so the book can't fake diversification.

title: Half-Kelly position sizing
note: Positions now scale by the book's own measured half-Kelly fraction: proven edge sizes up (capped 1.5x), a break-even book sizes down (floored 0.5x). Composes with conviction / volatility / regime multipliers.

title: Open-book heat + VaR
note: Portfolio heat (total open risk-to-stop vs a cap) plus a parametric 95% VaR / CVaR on the positions held right now — the aggregate, forward-looking risk per-trade sizing can't see.

title: AI committee vote counts + is graded
note: The 4-analyst LLM committee's verdict now counts toward conviction AND is graded by attribution like any other check, so its influence is earned from real outcomes — vote AND verify.

title: Regime-weighted confluence
note: Agreeing strategies are now weighted by how well their KIND fits the tape (breakouts earn full credit trending, less in chop; mean-reversion the mirror), instead of a flat count.

title: Wyckoff VSA footprint
note: A smart-money read from volume vs price spread — absorption / upthrust / no-demand — surfaced as a new accumulation/distribution conviction check.

title: Bonferroni p-hack guard
note: Attribution now demands statistical significance (corrected for testing many checks at once) before it up-weights or retires a check — so the engine can't chase a check that only looked good by luck.

title: Drawdown-recovery ladder
note: After a drawdown the book eases risk back in gradually (25 -> 50 -> 75 -> 100%), stepping up only after a clean, profitable run, instead of snapping back to full size.

title: Performance & risk metrics
note: An institutional read on the traded book: expectancy, System Quality Number, profit factor, Sortino, Kelly, Monte-Carlo drawdown/ruin and historical VaR/CVaR — all in R.

title: Parabolic Exhaustion Short
note: A short setup that waits for a parabola to actually crack before acting, on probation from the blanket short-gate so a validated new edge can build its own record.

title: Momentum Burst + Episodic Pivot
note: Two ported entry setups (Stockbee 4% burst; catalyst-driven episodic pivot / PEAD) scoring into conviction, with EP families inferred from real headlines.

title: O'Neil market timing + gate
note: Follow-Through-Day confirmation + distribution-day counter on SPY/QQQ. Tilts exposure and blocks new longs in a confirmed correction until an FTD re-arms.

title: Walk-forward self-validation
note: Every ported edge (timing states + each setup) now reports its own forward-return hit rate vs baseline on real history, and self-weights from it. Feeds the nightly analyst.

title: Data hygiene fixes
note: Malformed tickers (SPAC units) dropped on every path; unadjusted split/spinoff gaps (e.g. HON) truncated so indicators run on one clean price basis.
